## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5). Confirmations: broad sector participation but mixed internals — oversized tech winners (INTC/QCOM/GOOGL ABOVE TREND) offset by CORRECTIONs in NVDA/META and weakness in Healthcare/Materials, supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY.  
Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +5.50%) ABOVE TREND.  
Technology showing leadership concentration: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Healthcare lagging: SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND, despite UNH strength.  
Consumer Discretionary mixed with pockets of weakness: BKNG (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) RECOVERY while SBUX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +17.11%) ABOVE TREND.  
Materials weak: FCX (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.52% | 1M: +0.86%) RECOVERY, SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) RECOVERY.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY — watch the divergence as NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION shows distribution among big tech.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but influential; GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND while NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION and META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION underline internal rotation. Tech breadth intact overall but leadership concentrated.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND; sector participation supportive — style tilt toward Value/Cyclical as Industrials and Energy also show strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure: SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND despite UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND; internal dispersion suggests defensive caution.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Energy and Financials and select Consumer Staples names given current rotation and sector participation; reduce exposure to high-multiple names that are in CORRECTION (NVDA, META, AMAT). Monitor INTC/QCOM/GOOGL strength but note narrow leadership and healthcare/materials risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +0.64%) showing follow-through and Financials (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +6.97%) for cyclical leadership.  
BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -2.51%) and Materials (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +2.52%) where weakness and negative headlines may spill into earnings season.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: failure to reclaim this week’s pivot would deepen CORRECTION; watch weekly close above recent highs for trend repair.  
GOOGL: continued closes above this week’s gap support would confirm ABOVE TREND continuation.  
INTC: hold weekly momentum and > prior pivot to keep ABOVE TREND run intact.  
JPM: sustained strength above recent 1M trend supports Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
GD (+80): GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY — upgrade/guidance beat confirmed by price action.  
MPC (+60): MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND — news and price in sync (accumulation).  
UNH (+65): UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND — Q1 beat and rally confirming momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
SYK (-50): SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND — negative note and price decline confirm downside.  
SHW (-50): SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND — bearish research and price action aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Energy, Financials and Industrials show participation while leadership remains narrow. INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is leadership concentration and tech divergences (NVDA/META CORRECTION) plus isolated negative healthcare sentiment (SYK/ISRG) — monitor for trend confirmation.
